text_block_list.text:
While watching a certain race from the 
spectator stands—

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
—And now! With her legs dancing in pure 
elegance! Fine Motion takes a magnificent 
1st place!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOAAAH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Phew~, that was delightful♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, Dober! Wah, you came to watch!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Let me say it properly... Great job out 
there, Fine. And congratulations on taking 
1st place!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You were really fast. And on top of 
that... you were so breathtakingly 
beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Really? I can't tell myself, but running 
felt truly wonderful—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Fine, you were incredible out there! So 
powerful!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Your running form was so beautiful, I was 
completely moved to tears...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wawa! T-Thank you! My, everyone seems so 
thoroughly overjoyed, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Even though I was just running happily.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was truly moved by your run. It 
was so graceful, and your form was 
impeccable...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It was like gazing upon a masterpiece 
painting. ...Even I couldn't take my eyes 
off you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're exaggerating~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Though... I see. My running has become a 
wonderful memory for everyone, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't doing it for someone else's sake 
at first, but making people happy brings 
me so much joy♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I feel energy welling up inside me! 
At this rate, I can give my very best in 
the live show too♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll be watching from backstage. You're 
going to make our hearts race again, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Look forward to thrills just like in 
the race♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Phew~, it's almost time. My opening 
greeting will be—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone, thank you so very much for 
all of your wonderful cheers.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
For me, today's race has become an 
unforgettable memory.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
To conclude these lovely memories, please 
allow me to convey my deepest gratitude 
through a heartfelt song♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Yup, perfect! Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone, thank you so very much for 
all of your wonderful cheers.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now then, because I am Fine, please enjoy 
my gratitude fighting pose...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding! Please enjoy my song 
instead♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: All right, perfect! Here I goooo~!
